parakeet: Why is it crucial for this relationship to begin with your own death? It matters that your very first act of faith is your own symbolic execution, because nothing breaks your will as effectively as a mock death. By staging your burial underwater, the church forces a visceral lesson. Life isn't yours to claim. It's a gift they alone can confer. You emerge gasping, not triumphant, but indebted, your relief, mistaken for spiritual rebirth. In that moment you learn that without their rules, you're nothing more than a corpse. And that lesson cements the institution or ideology as the sole arbiter of your beginning and your end.
